description: This file contains template implementations of safe math operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication) with support for compile-time checks and fallbacks, primarily for use with Clang and GCC compilers. It includes boilerplate structures for unsupported assembler-optimized routines and defines various operation structs with support status and inline methods.

classes.name: CheckedMulFastAsmOp
classes.description: Boilerplate implementation for unsupported fast multiplication assembly routines.

classes.name: ClampedAddFastAsmOp
classes.description: Boilerplate implementation for unsupported clamped addition assembly routines.

classes.name: ClampedSubFastAsmOp
classes.description: Boilerplate implementation for unsupported clamped subtraction assembly routines.

classes.name: ClampedMulFastAsmOp
classes.description: Boilerplate implementation for unsupported clamped multiplication assembly routines.

methods.name: Do
methods.description: Performs the respective safe math operation (add, sub, mul) with compile-time support status and fallback to built-in overflow checks.
